chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from a man, from Suleman ibn Khalid, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

You should say: 'I testify that there is no god but Allah, and I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad, Your servant and Your Messenger. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and accept his intercession, and whiten his face, and increase his followers.'
O Allah, forgive me, and have mercy on me, and turn towards me. O Allah, forgive those who repented and followed Your way, and protect them from the punishment of the Blazing Fire.
So if he was a believer, he would be included in it, and if he was not a believer, he would be excluded from it.

key_terms.بَيِّضْ وَجْهَهُ: whiten his face (symbolizing honor and purity)
key_terms.عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ: the punishment of the Blazing Fire

ai.seo_question: What is the specific prayer to recite for a deceased Muslim who is weak in faith or understanding?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this supplication serves as a comprehensive intercessory prayer for the deceased, emphasizing the dual role of the Prophet Muhammad as both servant and intercessor. It reflects the Shia theological principle that specific invocations can extend spiritual benefit to the deceased, contingent upon their faith status, thereby linking earthly supplication with divine judgment.
